query:
UPDATE directions d
           SET auto_paused = EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM direction_pauses p WHERE p.direction = d.code),
               pause_reason = (SELECT p.reason FROM direction_pauses p WHERE p.direction = d.code
                                ORDER BY p.since, p.kind, p.platform LIMIT 1),
               updated_at = now()
         WHERE d.code = ANY($1)
